paragraphs: The AMG GT Roadster uses the M178 - a 4.0-litre V8 petrol twin-turbo engine. It was fitted from 2015 to 2023 across the C190 generation. The AMG GT Roadster is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every AMG GT ROADSTER on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the AMG GT ROADSTER from 2023 to present. The M256 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.
